rows.note: This is the usual term for a worker hired to move household belongings from one home to another.

example.english: We hired a mover to help move the furniture.
example.traditional: 我哋請咗個搬屋工人幫手搬啲傢俬。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 go3 bun1 uk1 gung1 jan4 bong1 sau2 bun1 di1 gaa1 si1

rows.note: Use this descriptive construction for a person or thing that is moving when no more specific noun is intended.

example.english: That mover is my younger brother; he can never sit still.
example.traditional: 嗰個郁嘅人係我細佬，成日坐唔定。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 juk1 ge3 jan4 hai6 ngo5 sai3 lou2 seng4 jat6 co5 m4 ding6
